summary: Aegon Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders (AGM) held on June 10, 2026. The AGM approved all resolutions on the agenda, including the final dividend for 2025 of EUR 0.21 per common share (total dividend EUR 0.40 per common share), the extension of CEO Lard Friese's term until the 2030 AGM, and the appointment of Leni Boeren to the Board of Directors. This is a routine current report of ordinary corporate governance matters, not a special situation. The filing contains no event that triggers any of the defined special-situation categories.
